news.headline: AI 股連跌第二天：黃仁勳回任的激勵效果消退
news.headline_en: AI rout continues as market exuberance fades over improbable return of Nvidia's Huang
news.plain: 週一因黃仁勳意外回任輝達執行長而大漲的 AI 股，週二、週三連續回跌；市場也擔心美國要對中國等 15 個貿易夥伴提高關稅、10 月物價再升溫。輝達週三收跌 3.9%。
news.plain_en: AI stocks that surged Monday on Jensen Huang's surprise reinstatement as Nvidia CEO fell again Tuesday and Wednesday, as markets also worried about new US tariffs on China and 15 other partners and a pickup in October inflation. Nvidia closed down 3.9% Wednesday.
news.why_me: 你的輝達、台積電、0050、00881 都跟 AI 情緒連動。現在的大起大落是情緒在拉扯，不是公司獲利突然改變；照規則：輝達不加碼，台股部位暫不增加科技曝險。
news.why_me_en: Your NVIDIA, TSMC, 0050 and 00881 all move with AI sentiment. These swings reflect mood, not a sudden change in earnings. Per your rules: don't add NVIDIA, and don't add tech exposure in Taiwan.
news.source: 美聯社 AP（BNN Bloomberg 轉載）

news.headline: 10 月 PCE 物價偏高，但資金買公債避險、殖利率下滑
news.headline_en: 10-year Treasury yield slides despite sticky inflation data as investors buy bonds for protection
news.plain: Fed 最在意的 PCE 物價指標 10 月仍然偏高，市場普遍預期 Fed 12/8～9 開會可能升息；不過股市動盪，資金湧進公債避險，10 年期殖利率反而下降到約 4.85%。
news.plain_en: October PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, stayed sticky, and markets expect a possible Fed hike at the Dec 8–9 meeting. But with stocks volatile, investors bought Treasuries for safety, pushing the 10-year yield down to about 4.85%.
news.why_me: 利率高、可能還要升息，對成長股（輝達、Google）的估值是壓力。你不用動作，但這是為什麼現金部位要先保留、分批計畫要照規則走。
news.why_me_en: High and possibly rising rates pressure growth-stock valuations (NVIDIA, Google). No action needed, but it is why you keep cash and stick to the staged plan.

news.headline: 新台幣爆量重貶 1.87 角，收 33.126 元
news.headline_en: Taiwan dollar slumps 0.187 on heavy volume to close at 33.126
news.plain: 台股週三重挫 1,927 點，外資賣超超過 1,200 億並大量匯出，新台幣跌破 33 元、創近 20 個月新低，成交量是史上第三大。
news.plain_en: As Taiwan stocks fell 1,927 points, foreign investors sold over NT$120B and moved money out; the TWD broke past 33 to a roughly 20-month low on the third-largest volume on record.
news.why_me: 台幣變弱，你的美股（輝達、Google、嬌生）換算成台幣反而增值，所以輝達占比也跟著被推高。不用為了匯率動作，但記得減碼門檻是用台幣總資產計算。
news.why_me_en: A weaker TWD raises the TWD value of your US stocks, which also pushes up NVIDIA's weight. No action for FX alone, but remember your trim threshold is measured in TWD.

valuation.name: Google
valuation.note: 採用預估本益比、P/B、殖利率三法；PEG 因 EPS 含投資收益、成長率被灌水而排除。Morningstar 450 只當樂觀參考。
valuation.note_en: Uses forward P/E, P/B and dividend-yield methods; PEG excluded because investment gains inflate EPS growth. Morningstar $450 is an optimistic reference only.

valuation.name: 輝達
valuation.note: 5 年平均本益比 32 倍含 AI 泡沫期，不採用；殖利率法（股息太少）與 PEG（試算表公式誤植，且 95% 成長不可持續）也排除。改用預估 EPS × 15～20 倍（S&P 500 約 18 倍），並以 P/B 286 交叉驗證。
valuation.note_en: The 32x five-year average P/E reflects bubble years, so it is not used; the yield method (tiny dividend) and PEG (sheet formula error, 95% growth unsustainable) are excluded too. Uses forward EPS × 15–20x (S&P 500 is about 18x), cross-checked with P/B 286.

valuation.name: 嬌生
valuation.note: 四種方法都在 165～210 之間，結論一致：現價明顯偏貴。PEG 98 偏低（成長率被專利到期拉低）不採用。
valuation.note_en: All four methods land between 165 and 210, a consistent verdict: the current price is clearly expensive. PEG (98) is excluded as patent expiries depress growth.

valuation.name: 博通
valuation.note: 預估本益比與 PEG 都在 390 上下；P/B 受 VMware 併購影響偏低，只當下限參考；殖利率法股息太少不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E and PEG both land near 390; P/B is depressed by the VMware deal and serves only as a floor; the yield method is excluded (dividend too small).

valuation.name: 高通
valuation.note: 預估本益比、殖利率、PEG 都在 128～143；P/B 受大量買回扭曲不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E, yield and PEG all land between 128 and 143; P/B is distorted by heavy buybacks and excluded.
